notes.text: Available in cPanel 90 and later. Disabled when the WebServer role is disabled. Lists weblog analyzer settings for each domain on the selected account; no domain selector or request defaults are documented.

Only analyzers enabled for this user on the system are shown. enabled is the cumulative administrator/user setting for the domain; enabled_by_user records the user choice. These are integer 0/1 flags, with optional name, analyzers and domain fields preserved. Empty lists remain empty.

Additional analyzer settings remain in responseMeta()->uapi[metadata], separate from the returned domain list. The metadata analyzers have available_for_user, enabled_by_default and name; metadata locked=1 means only the reseller or root can manage configuration and locked=0 means the cPanel user can manage it. The metadata description is not a typed payload contract and establishes no analyzer execution behavior.

notes.text: Account-wide replacement: explicitly read StatsManager/get_configuration first and supply the complete intended domain/analyzer set for this account. A partial-looking input can reset other settings to defaults. The client performs no implicit read, merge, patch, retry, restore or rollback.

The PR73 reviewer inspected the 11.138.0.19 handler: it builds defaults for every domain/analyzer, applies supplied changes, then saves. Its POD says unspecified configurations are disabled. These are attributed upstream findings, not a successful typed-client write or a promise that every default is universally disabled.

The reviewer reports enabled == 1 comparison; no successful end-to-end write or bool mapping was observed. Names remain strings without a closed analyzer enum. The pinned response description says locked=1 is user-manageable and locked=0 is root/reseller-controlled; do not infer semantics from the name.
